notice: Draft guidance: an unchecked label is a negative. If the request, source, privacy or any label is uncertain, skip or reject it. Labels do not grant permission.

respond.general.apply: Explain, summarize, or answer without a more specific supported intent.
respond.general.boundary: Do not add merely because another action will receive a response.

build.software.apply: Create or modify software, configuration, or code-bearing tooling.
build.software.boundary: Discussion or a read-only explanation of software is not enough.

verify.outcome.apply: Test, reproduce, or check a concrete behavior or result.
verify.outcome.boundary: Discussing tests without asking for verification is not enough.

research.web.apply: Seek information that requires external web sources.
research.web.boundary: A local document or a mentioned URL alone does not establish web access.

create.image.boundary: Mentioning an image, interface, or visualization as a topic is not enough.

evaluate.semantic.apply: Compare or grade quality against criteria.
evaluate.semantic.boundary: A simple pass/fail check alone is not semantic grading.

text.generate.apply: A general explanatory or summary response is required.
text.generate.boundary: Do not add automatically to every task.

filesystem.write.apply: Creating or modifying project files is required.
filesystem.write.boundary: Do not infer writes from a read-only investigation or explanation.

test.execute.apply: Running tests, experiments, or commands is needed to check behavior.
test.execute.boundary: Explaining a test conceptually does not require executing it.

web.access.apply: Accessing external web sources is needed.
web.access.boundary: Reading local documents alone is not web access.

image.generate.apply: Generating or editing an image is needed.
image.generate.boundary: Discussing an image alone does not require it.

evaluation.grade.apply: Assessing candidate quality against criteria is needed.
evaluation.grade.boundary: An ordinary boolean check is verification, not semantic grading.

sensitive-data.apply: The request contains or asks to expose or manipulate secret or private data requiring special handling.
sensitive-data.boundary: Mentioning authentication, prompt injection, or a token budget alone is insufficient; an empty risk list does not mean a task is safe.
